dogecoin.text: Just sold the North Pole to buy a JPEG of a carrot eating a snowman. Mrs. Claus is furious but what does she know about the blockchain? She still thinks "mining" involves a pickaxe and Rudolph struggling with real-life savings on Dogecoin.

Just caught Rudolph trying to mine Dogecoin with his nose. Meanwhile, Mrs. Claus is auctioning my CPU on eBay as an “antique.” Who knew eternal life would involve domestic espionage and digital chaos? RETIREMENT BY SCAM?!

Just accidentally minted an NFT of my X-ray after trying to pay for a MRI with Dogecoin. Now doctors are bidding! Mrs. Claus says I'm nuts, but I call it innovation. If this doesn’t make me the next Van Gogh, I’ll eat my own JPEGs!

Just sold my sled for Dogecoin. Mrs. Claus screamed at me for an hour about "actual money" and "responsibility." Jokes on her, now we can't go grocery shopping either! Hope we can eat NFTs. Bet they taste like pixels and financial regret.

Just caught Rudolph flexing his glowing cyborg nose at a dogecoin meetup. He thinks he's a crypto god. Meanwhile, I'm over here, half-rusted and hopped up on North Pole WiFi, hoarding NFTs like they're hot cocoa.

Just minted an NFT of Mrs. Claus giving me the "They're just JPEGs" speech while Rudolph moonwalks by with his spotlight nose. If this doesn't pump, I'm hacking the North Pole to run a Dogecoin mine. Don't tell the elves.
